title: Para Bellum content: economy
description: The economy's standing figures. File: Content/<namespace>/economy.json, exactly ONE across every namespace: the game refuses a second copy and refuses a content set with none. A mod cannot override this file (a recorded limitation). Unit costs, training days and speeds are NOT here: they are properties of a unit and live on its template row. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

upkeep_money_per_unit_per_month.description: Money each unit costs per month to keep.

draft_per_mille.description: The share of a seat's manpower actually drafted, per mille.

dispersed_yield_per_hex.description: Monthly yield of each resource-bearing hex, keyed by pool. The steel entry is unreachable since steel deposits retired into mills; it is kept rather than deleted, and deleting it is a separate decision.

seed_months.description: How many months of income each nation's pools start with.
